title: Faithful Mace Craftable
description: This datapack adds craftability craftability to the items from the 1.20.1 Fabric Mod Faithful Mace.
body:
# Requirements
This Datapack requires [NBT Recipes](https://modrinth.com/mod/nbt-recipes).
# Description
This datapack adds craftability to the fabric mod [Faithful Mace](https://modrinth.com/mod/faithful-mace), it adds recipes for all 3 enchantment books on level III and the mace.
